## What's Changed
* docs: shorten How It Works section by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-trip-meter/pull/8
* ci: add Dependabot for Bun deps and actions by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-trip-meter/pull/9
* docs: add npm version badge to README by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-trip-meter/pull/10
* build(deps): bump the actions group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-trip-meter/pull/11
* build(deps-dev): bump the deps group with 6 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-trip-meter/pull/12
* feat: show token counts for models without pricing by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-trip-meter/pull/13
* build: bump version to 0.2.0 by @belambert in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-trip-meter/pull/14

## New Contributors
* @dependabot[bot] made their first contribution in https://github.com/belambert/opencode-trip-meter/pull/11

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/belambert/opencode-trip-meter/compare/v0.1.1...v0.2.0
First release published from CI via npm trusted publishing. No code changes since v0.1.0; the README now lists the CLI install first.

First release. OpenCode sidebar plugin showing tokens/sec, the current model's per-token prices, and per-category session spend.

    opencode plugin add opencode-trip-meter

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-trip-meter
